verdict.rationale: Radar has its own API surface for headless automation: review approval endpoints, value lists, and early fraud warnings. It also offers sandbox test cards that produce specific risk levels, which suits CI tests, and Stripe documents an official CLI. However, custom rules are documented as Dashboard-created, and nothing shows a Radar-specific CI workflow. Missing for 10: API or CLI management of Radar rules and risk settings, explicit Radar-in-CI guidance, evidence the CLI covers Radar, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
